description.value: The Rosewood Hotel Georgia is a beautifully restored 1927 heritage landmark in the heart of downtown Vancouver, operating as a full-service luxury hotel with a spa, fitness centre, pool, and six distinct dining and bar venues on-site. The property is steps from Vancouver's shopping, entertainment district, and offers quick access to Stanley Park. Touring cyclists would find it a high-end urban base with extensive in-house dining options.
